proposals.evidence: Turner asau explicitly supplies Old Marwari vo, Hindi wah, Punjabi/Lahnda o and Nepali u as remote demonstratives and third-person forms. Only third-person or distal-labelled responses are included; this/these responses and extra lexical material are excluded.
